definitions.explanation: Describes a cliff, rock face, or slope that rises or drops almost vertically, as if cut with a blade. Used as an attributive modifier before nouns.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両側|りょうがわ}→両側：28877_ryougawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{立|た}った{岩壁|がんぺき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦そびえていた→そびえる：10360_sobieru⟧。
examples.english: Sheer rock walls towered on both sides of the road.

examples.japanese: {切|き}り{立|た}った⟦{断崖|だんがい}→断崖：05039_dangai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見下|みお}ろした→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧。
examples.english: I looked down at the sea from atop a precipitous cliff.

notes:
The past-tense form of the compound verb {切|き}り{立|た}つ (to rise steeply), used almost exclusively as an attributive adjective modifying nouns. The image is of rock that looks as though it has been cleanly cut (⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧) and stands upright (⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{立|た}った⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧: a sheer cliff
- {切|き}り{立|た}った⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧: a steep rock face
- {切|き}り{立|た}った⟦{断崖|だんがい}→断崖：05039_dangai⟧: a precipitous cliff
- {切|き}り{立|た}った{山肌|やまはだ}: a steep mountainside

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{険|けわ}しい→険しい：08154_kewashii⟧: steep, rugged — more general; can also mean severe or stern
- ⟦{急峻|きゅうしゅん}→急峻：21358_kyuushun⟧な: precipitous, very steep — formal, literary
- {断崖絶壁|だんがいぜっぺき}: sheer precipice — a set noun phrase for a cliff with no footholds
